==Company==
AJAX Engineering is a joint venture of [[Fiori Group]].<ref name="one">{{Cite web |title=AJAX About Us |url=https://www.ajax-engg.com/about-us |access-date=2026-01-11 |website=www.ajax-engg.com |publisher=AJAX Engineering Ltd. |language=en-GB |archive-date=2025-11-08 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251108161348/https://ajax-engg.com/about-us |url-status=live }}</ref>

It is the first Indian concreting equipment manufacturer to export Slip-Form Paver.<ref>{{Cite web |title=AJAX Engineering becomes first Indian concreting equipment manufacturer to export SLIP-FORM PAVER
|url=https://equipmenttimes.in/ajax-engineering-becomes-first-indian-concreting-equipment-manufacturer-to-export-slip-form-paver-1653 |website=Equipment Times |language=en}}</ref>
